name: Circle
description: Issuer of USDC and EURC. Agents can transfer/approve USDC and EURC on each supported chain (including gasless permit and EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on EVM) and move native USDC between chains by burning and minting through CCTP, using Circle's attestation (Iris) API.

Burn USDC to mint on another chain. Args: amount, destinationDomain (CCTP domain ID, not chain ID), mintRecipient (address left-padded to bytes32), burnToken (USDC address on this chain), destinationCaller (bytes32(0) = anyone may call receiveMessage), maxFee (in USDC base units), minFinalityThreshold (1000 = Fast Transfer, 2000 = Standard). Approve USDC to TokenMessengerV2 first. Max $10M per burn.
Same as depositForBurn plus hookData bytes delivered with the message for custom logic on the destination chain.
Minimum fee for a burn amount; maxFee must be at least this when a standard fee applies.
On the destination chain: submit the message bytes and Circle attestation (both from the Iris API /v2/messages) to mint USDC to mintRecipient. Each nonce can be used once.

offchainApis.name: CCTP attestation API (Iris) - mainnet
offchainApis.use: GET /v2/messages/{sourceDomainId}?transactionHash=0x... returns the message and attestation for a burn (poll until status complete), then pass both to MessageTransmitterV2.receiveMessage on the destination. Also GET /v2/burn/USDC/fees/{sourceDomainId}/{destDomainId} (fees for maxFee), GET /v2/fastBurn/USDC/allowance (Fast Transfer allowance), POST /v2/quote/burn/usdc/{sourceDomainId}/{destDomainId} (fee quote), POST /v2/reattest/{nonce}, GET /v2/publicKeys; legacy GET /v1/attestations/{messageHash} and /v1/messages/{sourceDomainId}/{transactionHash}. Rate limit 40 requests/second; exceeding it blocks all requests for 5 minutes (HTTP 429).

actions.name: gasless-approve
actions.how: sign EIP-2612 permit, then anyone calls USDC.permit(owner, spender, value, deadline, v, r, s)

actions.name: bridge-usdc
actions.description: Move native USDC to another chain with CCTP V2
actions.how: 1) USDC.approve(TokenMessengerV2, amount); 2) TokenMessengerV2.depositForBurn(amount, destDomain, bytes32(recipient), USDC, bytes32(0), maxFee, 1000 fast | 2000 standard) with maxFee from GET /v2/burn/USDC/fees/{src}/{dst}; 3) poll GET https://iris-api.circle.com/v2/messages/{srcDomain}?transactionHash=<burn tx> until attestation is ready; 4) on destination call MessageTransmitterV2.receiveMessage(message, attestation)

actions.name: check-blacklist
actions.description: Check whether Circle has frozen an address

risks: Centralised issuer: the FiatToken blacklister role can blacklist any address; a blacklisted address cannot call transfer/transferFrom and cannot receive tokens (stablecoin-evm token design doc).
The pauser role can pause the whole token, blocking all transfers, mints and burns.
EVM USDC/EURC are upgradeable (FiatTokenProxy, unstructured-storage proxy delegating to FiatToken); the admin role can switch the implementation.

CCTP: destinationDomain is Circle's domain ID (e.g. Ethereum 0, Avalanche 1, OP 2, Arbitrum 3, Solana 5, Base 6, Polygon 7, Unichain 10), not the EVM chain ID. A wrong mintRecipient encoding loses funds. $10M max per burn; Fast Transfers are limited by a global allowance and carry a fee.
CCTP V1 (Legacy) deprecation began October 31, 2026 and completes December 1, 2026; message limits tighten until no new burns are possible and contracts are paused. Use V2 for new transfers.
Bridged USDC (e.g. USDC.e) on some chains is not issued by Circle; only addresses on Circle's page are native USDC.
notes: Token addresses are copied from Circle's USDC and EURC contract-address pages (EVM addresses checksummed). CCTP V2 EVM addresses are identical on most chains (TokenMessengerV2 0x28b5a0e9C621a5BadaA536219b3a228C8168cf5d, MessageTransmitterV2 0x81D40F21F12A8F0E3252Bccb954D722d4c464B64) except EDGE. Also on the CCTP V2 page but not listed as contracts here: TokenMinterV2 (0xfd78EE919681417d192449715b2594ab58f5D002 on most chains), MessageV2 (0xec546b6B005471ECf012e5aF77FBeC07e0FD8f78) and TokenMessengerWithFees (0x71f54F818671cD0D7ea140Da213e5C8b5C92a408 on 18 chains) - see https://developers.circle.com/cctp/references/contract-addresses. CCTP on Starknet, Stellar, Sui, Aptos and Noble: see Circle's non-EVM references (not included). BNB Smart Chain is CCTP domain 17 for USYC only. EVM keyFunctions follow Circle's FiatToken (stablecoin-evm) design; verify with get_abi. chainId is null where Circle's page does not give it and it was not confirmed (Arc, Codex, EDGE, Pharos). proxy is null because per-address proxy status was not confirmed from Circle's pages, though FiatToken is designed to sit behind FiatTokenProxy.
